attributes.title: Level 2

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using sequence in your projects to run code in a specific order!

questions.hint: How does sequence help computers understand how to run code?
questions.title: [Select one] What is a sequence?

answers.text: The specific order of steps in code

questions.correctResponse: Restore a little order with sequence!

questions.hint: What might happen if the sequence in a project is incorrect?
questions.title: [Select one] If the sequence of your code is incorrect, the computer will always give you an error message.
questions.correctResponse: Sometimes, even if the sequence is incorrect, the program still runs, but will usually behave in a strange or unexpected way.

questions.hint: What might happen if the sequence in a project is incorrect?
questions.title: [Select all that apply] An incorrect sequence can lead to __________ or __________.

answers.text: The game you wanted to make

questions.correctResponse: Sequence bugs lead to confusion! Some stop the program from running; whereas, others run but with unwanted results.

questions.hint: Which option is correctly sequenced? Which option would throw an error?
questions.title: [Match one per answer] Match the following:

statements.text: Brush your teeth right before a meal
Follow a recipe step by step as instructed
List the weekend as Saturday, Friday, Sunday

questions.correctResponse: Does the order make sense? If not, does it just feel mixed up or does it stop you in your tracks?

questions.hint: Should you debug your project all the time or only sometimes?
questions.title: [Select one] As long as your project works, you do not need to debug your code.
questions.correctResponse: Although you may not get any errors, you will need to debug if your  program behaves in a strange or unexpected way.

subgroups.title: Sequence!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using sequence in your projects to run code in a specific order!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of White Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about using sequence, which is the specific order of steps in code, to make your projects run correctly! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: Step by Step
badges.description: Use sequence to control the order in which things happen in a project.

badges.title: What’s in a Name?
badges.description: Change the name of a sprite variable.

badges.title: Storyteller
badges.description: Add a dialog box and set its position on screen.

badges.title: That Belongs in a Museum!
badges.description: Add a frame to a dialog box.
